moduleInfo.moduleDesc: AnimePahe public-API browsing with paired experimental native-source probes and the known-working site WebView player fallback.
moduleInfo.changelog: v1.2 experimental: each episode now offers Native Probe and Web Player entries. The native probe follows public embed pages and accepts only plainly exposed HLS or MP4 URLs; it does not unpack scripts, solve verification challenges, or bypass access controls. WebView playback remains available for every episode.
